An Augmented Intelligence Technology Architecture is the description of the models, hosts, tools, knowledge and decision components used to support the business components of a company, together with the division of decision labour, between people and machines, that each decision component embodies.
The centre of it is not a model catalogue; it is a set of decisions the business makes, some of which a machine now participates in.
The decision component is the unit of analysis.

Every decision component carries a mode: AUTOMATION, where it executes without a human decision; AUGMENTATION, where a person decides with machine participation; or UNDETERMINED, where no one has established which applies.
The undetermined count is the material finding.
It measures where the company has stopped knowing who decides, and in most companies it is unknown because no one has looked.
Mode is the admission test for the whole framework.
